title: Pais on Theory of Everything: plasma as doorway

tellings.quote: what Dr. In my opinion, not to speak for him, but that's what Dr. Pye spoke about when he was on Curt Jaimungal's Theory of Everything when he said that it's possible that you can induce these types of effects like inertial mass reduction and so on. Not with solids, but with plasmas

plain: It may be possible to reduce an object's inertial mass, making it behave as if it weighed less so it is easier to move, by using plasmas, the hot electrically charged gas, rather than solid materials. A guest named Dave Rossi, who says aliens taught him advanced physics, tells Michels this is his reading of what a scientist named Dr. Salvatore Pais said on Theory of Everything, a podcast hosted by Curt Jaimungal, while adding he does not speak for Pais. If true, it would point toward how unusual craft might fly.
